findings.defect: The omitted subject is resolved incorrectly as the speaker; Wipeng is telling Jin Mukyung that Mukyung smells of sweat.
findings.rationale: The surrounding exchange addresses Jin Mukyung directly: he came from training, smells of sweat, and is therefore ordered to wash.

findings.current: A thousand silver nyang was one hundred thousand nyang in copper coins.
findings.defect: The coin material is changed from iron to copper.
findings.rationale: 철전 explicitly means iron coins, and the source gives the conversion in those terms.
findings.replacement: A thousand silver nyang was worth one hundred thousand nyang in iron coins.
findings.source: 은자 천 냥이면 철전으로는 십만 냥이다.

findings.current: “A thousand silver nyang. One hundred thousand nyang in copper coins.”
findings.defect: The repeated conversion again changes iron coins to copper coins.
findings.rationale: 철전 denotes iron coins; the material must remain consistent in Hong Jin’s explanation.
findings.replacement: “A thousand silver nyang. That’s one hundred thousand nyang in iron coins.”

findings.current: How many of the Four Books and Three Classics someone had memorized, or what they had learned from which great scholar, wasn’t important.
findings.defect: “How many” changes the source’s extent of memorization into a count of whole canonical books.
findings.rationale: 얼마나 많이 asks how much material was memorized, not how many of the seven works were completed.
findings.replacement: How much of the Four Books and Three Classics someone had memorized, or what they had learned from which great scholar, wasn’t important.
findings.source: 사서삼경(四書三經)을 얼마나 많이 외웠느냐, 어느 석학의 문하에서 뭘 배웠느냐는 중요하지 않다.

findings.current: “Decent scholars, my ass. Do you have no eyes?”
findings.defect: The translation adds explicit profanity to a dismissive but nonprofane retort, unnecessarily intensifying Jin Wikyung’s register.
findings.rationale: 무슨 dismisses Wipeng’s description without the obscenity introduced by “my ass,” while 눈도 없나 questions his judgment of people.
findings.replacement: “Decent scholars? Please. Do you have no eye for people?”

findings.current: Jin Wikyung had heard the rumors about the palace attendant who sat at the top of the military hierarchy and controlled the young prince with a single hand.
findings.defect: “With a single hand” literalizes 혼자서 and fails to convey that Hong Jin allegedly dominates and manipulates the prince single-handedly.
findings.rationale: 혼자서 means by himself, while 쥐락펴락하다 means to control or manipulate someone at will.
findings.replacement: Jin Wikyung had heard the rumors about the palace attendant who sat at the top of the military hierarchy and single-handedly kept the young prince under his thumb.
findings.source: 진위경 역시 들어 본 기억이 있다. 군부의 꼭대기에 앉아 혼자서 어린 왕을 쥐락펴락한다는 내관에 관한 소문을.

findings.current: Hearing Hong Jin describe him like some vulgar man who had been bought off by a bribe didn’t sit well with me.
findings.defect: “Vulgar man” mistranslates 속물 and obscures that Taekyung resents Hong Jin depicting Wikyung as materialistic and easily bought.
findings.rationale: 속물 refers to a shallow, materially motivated person rather than someone merely vulgar or coarse.
findings.replacement: I didn’t appreciate Hong Jin making him out to be some materialistic opportunist who could be bought with a bribe.
findings.source: 그를 뇌물에 넘어간 속물처럼 표현하는 홍진이 곱게 보이지 않는 것이다.

findings.current: “Are there really this few people in the main family? No, wait. Are there really this few capable people in all of Shanxi Province?”
findings.defect: “Main family” does not follow the binding rendering of 본가, and both instances of “this few” are awkward in this question.
findings.rationale: 본가 refers to the speaker’s own family here, and “so few” is the natural English degree construction.
findings.replacement: “Does our family really have so few people? No—are there really so few capable people in all of Shanxi Province?”
findings.source: “본가에 이 정도로 사람이 없나? 아니지, 산서성에 기재가 이 정도로 없어?”

findings.current: At this point, he was cooked—cooked through.
findings.defect: The punchline changes 탔다, meaning that Wikyung has burned, into being merely cooked through, weakening the escalation from 구워삶다.
findings.rationale: The joke escalates from figuratively cooking someone into submission to having thoroughly burned him.
findings.replacement: At this point, he was burned—burned to a crisp.

summary: Actionable subject, currency-material, register, characterization, and wording errors.
